Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting residential densities of certain unincorporated portions of urban growth areas.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to land use planning in qualifying unincorporatedportions of urban growth areas; and adding a new section to chapter36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Prior to issuing a permit or other form of development approvalin an unincorporated portion of an urban growth area, the county andthe city or cities surrounding the unincorporated portion of the urbangrowth area must enter into an interlocal agreement under chapter 39.34RCW that: (a) Stipulates the density that will be allowed in theunincorporated portion of the urban growth area; (b) Specifies mitigation of transportation impacts on roads of thesurrounding city or cities; and (c) Stipulates how urban governmental services will be funded andprovided in the unincorporated portion of the urban growth area. (2) Subsection (1) of this section applies only to unincorporatedportions of urban growth areas that: p. 1 SHB 1265 (a) Border Puget Sound; (b) Are surrounded on the landward side entirely by one or morecities; (c) Are one or more miles from any other portion of an urban growtharea that is in unincorporated territory; and (d) Are fifty or more acres in size.
